citations.claim: first controller_force_limit violation: commanded force exceeds fmax

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise from 0.27107 to 0.0 only; predicted this removes the overshoot because noise is added/applied after the fmax clamp without re-clamping. Counterfactual force is exactly at fmax and no violation.

explanation: Velocity-error law with kp~25.68 demands >fmax, so nominal command saturates at fmax=104.557 (counterfactual shows exactly 104.557). With noise=0.271, reported force is 135.924, ~31 above limit. Likely cause: seeded sensor noise is applied to the measured state/velocity error after (or outside) the fmax saturation/clamp, so the noisy correction is never re-clamped to fmax.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body sits slightly below the green waypoint and barely shifts between step 0 and step 1. No collision, penetration, or large motion is visible, so the violation has no obvious visual signature.
